verdict.rationale: Unity's first-party docs cover editor extension directly: custom inspectors, Editor Windows and Property Drawers, plus public scripting APIs and the Asset Database for programmatic asset handling. Packages provide a plugin distribution path, and command-line arguments and the new CLI (`unity eval` and `unity <command>`) can drive the Editor for automation. Missing for 10: no explicit documentation of programmatic scene manipulation APIs (only implied), and no independent or hands-on corroboration of editor-scripting depth.
